subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: After the shared reply-session self-heal in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 is considered, should Discord also keep a bounded channel-level retry/replay defense for residual initialization conflicts?
rationale: Repository policy treats fallback behavior as an explicit product decision, and the shared PR addresses the core conflict while this PR adds a second channel-owned recovery layer with distinct delivery and replay semantics.

options.title: Keep layered Discord defense
options.body: Repair this PR to retry only prepared dispatch, then keep bounded Discord recovery as defense in depth after the shared self-heal.

options.title: Rely on shared recovery
options.body: Pause or close this PR if the shared self-heal is selected as the sole canonical recovery and proves Discord no longer needs a transport-level fallback.

recommendation.title: Keep layered Discord defense
recommendation.body: Repair this PR to retry only prepared dispatch, then keep bounded Discord recovery as defense in depth after the shared self-heal.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision turns on the intended contract of guarded reply-session initialization and its shared self-heal behavior.
